description: Cases of the view import map insertion (docs/spec/plugin-processes.md, rule 4). A case gives the page text and the import map text (map, default the view import map). A case with output names the page after the insertion; a case with error names the reason the page is refused with. The insertion has the same result in the plugin-api function and in the native handler.

cases.name: inserts the map directly after the doctype
matches the doctype without regard to case
refuses a page without a doctype at its start
cases.error: view page has no doctype at its start

cases.name: refuses a page that holds an import map
cases.error: view page has an import map

cases.name: refuses a page whose import map has unquoted attributes
cases.error: view page has an import map

cases.name: refuses a map text that would end its script element
cases.error: import map text ends a script element

cases.name: refuses an empty map text
cases.error: the view import map is empty
